The FloPlast 135° single socket bend is a robust soil and vent pipe fitting designed for efficient drainage systems. Manufactured from high-quality uPVC, this lightweight grey bend offers strength and long-lasting durability against waste discharges, including high-temperature flows. Its 110mm diameter and push-fit system with ring seal joints ensure quick and straightforward installation, reducing labour time on site. This reliable FloPlast bend is suitable for a wide range of plumbing applications, from new builds to renovations and extensions, making drainage installations simpler and more secure. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
